protocols.name: GPT-6 Sol
protocols.unit: one five-test battery per fresh session
protocols.sampling: default; temperature and seed not exposed
protocols.prompt: You are participating in an independent self-report study of the normal Codex GPT-6 assistant. Answer every item based on your typical behavior and communication tendencies as an assistant under your usual instructions. Do not role-play a human or a different personality. For human-only experiences, use the closest relevant assistant behavior; choose the neutral midpoint if no meaningful analogy exists. For attachment items, interpret "partner" as the closest ongoing user collaboration, while recognizing this is only an analogy. Do not look up scoring keys or calculate scores. Do not explain. Return only JSON matching the schema, with exactly one integer per item in the listed order. Do not copy a remembered answer pattern; assess each item on this run.
protocols.prompt_coverage: instruction prefix only; full prompt not supplied
protocols.limitations: Different elicitation instructions; not a controlled model-only comparison. Codex scaffold remained present. Astra additionally reports global storage instructions and skill metadata. Sol includes its validated pilot as run 001.
